description: May 19 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a May 19 birthday falls in Taurus, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: May 19 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: One of the last fully Taurean dates, May 19th puts the Sun twenty-eight degrees into the Bull while the birthday number reduces to 1. Saturn's decan lends seriousness; the 1 lends initiative. Often read as an independent, determined person with a strong aesthetic sense, this birthday tends to start things slowly and finish them thoroughly, preferring its own pace to anyone else's.

On May 19 the Sun usually sits at about 28° Taurus, in the third decan, where Saturn is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. The closing decan of Taurus answers to Saturn, ruler of Capricorn, and this lends the sign's earthiness a long-range, structural quality. Instead of only enjoying what is solid, mid-May natives are often drawn to building it: savings, institutions, skills that compound over decades. Astrologers tend to call them serious, reliable and quietly ambitious, with a dry humour that surfaces once trust is established. Saturn can also bring a heavier sense of duty and a habit of postponing pleasure until some imagined finish line. Remembering that Taurus is a Venus sign first can help, because rest and beauty belong inside the structure too.

sections.heading: May 19 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one May 19 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on May 19: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: May brings late spring in the northern hemisphere, a season of blossom and long evenings, and late autumn to the southern. Taurus holds the first three weeks, with Gemini arriving around May 20 or 21. In numerology May is month 5, the number of freedom, curiosity and change, which tends to give these birthdays a restless, experimental streak beneath the calm Taurean surface. May 19 is the 139th day of the year (140th in a leap year). By May 21, 2 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Gemini.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by May 19, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on May 19 include Mustafa Kemal Atatürk (1881), Ho Chi Minh (1890) and Malcolm X (1925).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is May 19?
faq.answer: May 19 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on May 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On May 19 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on May 19?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a May 19 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on May 19?
faq.answer: May 19 is also the birthday of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk (1881), Ho Chi Minh (1890) and Malcolm X (1925). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
